scenes.audio: Marcus has earned his license.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: White rounded rectangle centered on beige background. Green arrow points right. High-key lighting, flat design.

scenes.audio: Keeping it active now requires a calendar, accurate records, and timely action.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Dark teal rectangle appears right of the first. Second green arrow appears. Static camera, neutral palette.

scenes.audio: Maryland producer licenses are generally renewed every two years. An individual's expiration is tied to the end of the birth month.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Third white rectangle with green border added far right. Horizontal row arrangement. Minimalist aesthetic.

scenes.audio: Renewal requires the appropriate application, fees, and qualifications. Continuing education has an earlier deadline. Do not wait until the last day of the license to begin a course.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Static layout of three colored rectangles on beige backdrop. Even lighting, no movement.

scenes.audio: A missed email is especially dangerous if the producer never updated the address held by the administration.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Continued static view of three rectangles. Flat color palette, soft shadows.

scenes.audio: For a typical Maryland resident life producer, the regular requirement is 24 approved continuing education hours in the renewal period, including at least three in ethics.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: New layout. Two rectangles side-by-side: left has black border, right has beige border. High-key lighting.

scenes.audio: Complete the required education no later than 15 days before license expiration. Hours must satisfy the applicable license-line requirements. Special statutory reductions, exceptions, and approved waivers exist.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Teal-bordered rectangle joins on the right. Static frame, horizontal symmetry.

scenes.audio: So do not present the regular rule as universal. A non-resident can satisfy Maryland's continuing education requirement through qualifying home-state compliance and reciprocity. This exam preparation course is not being represented as approved renewal credit.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: Static row of three rectangles remains on screen. Desaturated tones, minimalist graphics.

scenes.audio: An expired license is not a grace period for selling. Maryland prohibits insurance business until reinstatement is effective.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: New layout with three horizontal rectangles featuring black, beige, and teal borders. Static camera.

scenes.audio: For up to one year after expiration, reinstatement requires the appropriate application, renewal fees, a $100 reinstatement fee, and proof of required education.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Horizontal boxes continue on screen. Flat design, uniform lighting.

scenes.audio: An application within 60 days leads to retroactive reinstatement under the statute. An application later than 60 days leads to prospective reinstatement. That distinction does not authorize someone to keep working while expired.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: Static view of three boxes remains. Palette dominated by beige and off-white.

scenes.audio: A licensee must report changes in legal name, trade name, email address, or address within 30 days. Filing a trade name is not the same as obtaining new lines of authority.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: New screen displaying three colored rectangles in a row. Static frame, high-key lighting.

scenes.audio: There is also a separate 10-day rule for changes to the designated business entity contact's required information. Read the role named in the question before choosing the clock.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Layout remains static. Desaturated color palette, minimalist design.

scenes.audio: Moving between states can create additional resident or non-resident requirements. Updating an agency website alone does not update the administration's licensing record.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: Three rectangles persist on beige background. Even lighting, no motion.

scenes.audio: Two reporting rules are easy to confuse. A covered adverse administrative action taken by another jurisdiction or another Maryland government unit must be reported within 30 days after final disposition.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: New horizontal arrangement of three rectangles with black, beige, and teal borders.

scenes.audio: A covered criminal prosecution must be reported within 30 days after the initial court appearance. The criminal rule does not generally wait for a conviction.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Static horizontal boxes remain. Flat design, soft shadows.

scenes.audio: Maryland excludes misdemeanor violations of its vehicle law from that particular criminal reporting requirement. Use the actual statute and required documents for the event.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: Persistence of three-box layout. Minimalist palette, neutral lighting.

scenes.audio: Imagine Marcus changes his email, approaches renewal, and receives notice of a covered proceeding. These create separate duties with separate starting dates.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Vertical stack of four small rectangles appearing sequentially on off-white screen.

scenes.audio: He updates the licensing record, completes approved education by the earlier deadline, submits renewal on time, and reports the proceeding with the required records.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Static vertical list of four rectangles on beige screen. Flat graphic design.

scenes.audio: A timely and complete renewal application can preserve the existing license until the commissioner makes a final renewal decision. Identify the event, the person responsible, and the deadline each time.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: Final static view of vertical rectangle stack. Uniform high-key lighting.
